ops.title: PR269: reject nonregular .git files before reading
ops.description: Owner: Yasyf Mohamedali <yasyf@poetic.com>. Next: decline every nonregular, nondirectory .git entry before os.ReadFile. Evidence: internal/gitcmd/discover.go:70; /Users/yasyf/.vcache/scratch/ccn-write-floor-review/pr269-_qireoxt/discovery-results.txt:11. A FIFO blocked discovery until a writer supplied content; Git rejected it as not a regular file.

ops.text: A FIFO at .git declines without opening or blocking; Dirs returns the same error as Git and preserves cancellation.
